All State/UT Licensing Authorities.
Subject:- Piperacillin + Tazobactam related ‘Blurred Vision’ - Recommendations for
the change in Prescribing Information Leaflets (PILs)—regarding.

Sir,

The National Coordination Centre for Pharmacovigilance Programme of India (NCC-
PvPl), Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC), Ghaziabad, has forwarded
recommendations arising from the assessment of Adverse Drug Reaction (ADR) reports
pertaining to Piperacillin + Tazobactam formulations, which was discussed in 24" Signal
Review Panel dated 2" November, 2023. In the meeting, the PvPI has evaluated the Patient
Population Incidence - Adverse Drug Reactions (PPIs-ADR) based on Individual Case Study
Reports (ICSR) and made recommendation to CDSCO to take necessary measures to
incorporate “Blurred Vision” as an adverse drug reaction in to the Prescribing information
leaflet (PIL) of the Piperacillin + Tazobactam based medical products marketed in the
country.

The aforementioned recommendations of NCC-PvPI were subsequently reviewed by
the Subject Expert Committee (SEC) on (Antimicrobial & Antiparasitic) during its meeting
held on 09.04.2026 at CDSCO-HQ, New Delhi. After detailed deliberations, the committee
recommended that CDSCO should request the State Drugs Controllers to direct the
manufacturers to incorporate ‘Blurred Vision’ associated with Piperacillin +Tazobactam as
ADR in the corresponding Prescribing Information Leaflet (PIL) of the drug.

Page 1 of 2

The recommendation of the SEC has been considered by this office. Accordingly, you
are requested to direct the manufacturers of Piperacillin + Tazobactam formulations under
your jurisdiction to mention “Blurred Vision” as an adverse drug reaction in the Package
insert/Promotional Literature of the drug.

Action taken in this regard may be intimated to this office.
Yours faithfully,
(Dr.\Raje ingh\Raghuvanshi)
Drugs Controller General (India)
Copy for information & follow-up: -
1. All Zonal / Sub Zonal Offices of CDSCO.
